title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-05
summary: Prep notes for weekly exec/leadership sync. Focus on Dedicated capacity rollout, Private deployment milestones, cost/latency trends, hiring priority for infra SRE, and customer escalations. Draft talking points + open questions for product/eng owners.
agenda: Private deployments: compliance checklist + on-prem pilot status (10m)
Performance / cost: P50/P95 trends & Optimize recommendations (10m)
Hiring ask: infra SRE + applied-ml eng (7m)
notes: Opening: call out recent infra incident (2026-02-28) - root cause summary + mitigation done. Need SRE to confirm rollback cadence for future incidents.
Dedicated: schedule for GA target = 2026-03-20. Current blockers: autoscaler edge cases, billing metering mismatch for burst capacity. Michael to sync with billing team.
Capacity: projected Q2 committed usage vs. pool sizing - early estimates show 10% shortfall if we hit top-decile customer growth. Consider temporary burst quota or partner cloud capacity.
Private: legal signoff pending for EU customer (data residency + KMS). Priya to confirm HSM integration timeline (ETA: 2 weeks). On-prem package install docs are in review.
Performance: request from product to reduce P95 latency for chat endpoints by 15% without increasing unit cost >5%. Ops: try tighter batching windows + KV cache TTL tuning.
Optimize: last week's quantization experiments look promising for base models but regressions on a few eval prompts. Research to prepare A/B test plan with fallbacks.
Hiring: prioritize infra SRE hire (backfill + growth role). Draft interview rubric exists (link in artifacts). Proposal to accelerate recruiter outreach.
Customers: two escalations - acme-inc (latency spikes, enterprise) and healthco (private deploy compliance). CS has interim runbook; need exec-level customer reachout plan for Acme.
Metrics ask: bring token-level cost delta for last 14 days, per-model throughput, and error rates by region. Also include per-route tracing sample for one spike event.
Open questions: Do we accept partial GA with reduced SLA for non-enterprise customers? What's the fallback plan if KMS integration slips >3 weeks?
Logistics: reserve 1:1 follow-ups after meeting with owners of each action item. Prep one-slide status per owner for the meeting deck.
Quick notes to self: keep discussion timeboxed; push detailed technical debate to separate deep-dive session with eng leads.
